answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing, each measured or read. (1) Measured 2026-11-12: akienasus's local cairn db holds one *_nodes table and no codemother_* or chart_* tree, while akiendelllinux's codemother_orient_nodes holds 688 rows, so 2b3d842bc118's clause_4_the_live_tables_are_hers reds on akienasus. (2) Read press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt 11.3.5.1: a remote box keeps its own database and syncs it with the home box's. 4.3.1.5.1.1: row numbers are the same on every box, and slots are reserved from the home librarian. (3) No ticket cites 11.3.5.1 or 6.3.7.4's CAIRN_HOME_HOST for the db. (4) The built memory model is per-nexus tables (<owner>_<nexus>_nodes), not the outline's one long node list, so the sync's unit is not settled by the code.
answers.builder_check: A builder cannot start from this ticket today: it needs the design pass's answer on the sync's unit and transport. This is why BUILDME waits; the ticket says so in its how.

answers.collision_check: Outline 11.3.5.1 and 4.3.1.5.1.1 are the spec and this ticket serves them. One bus per instance, with a device on one box (memory one-bus-per-cairn-instance): the sync copies data, not devices, so it is not a duplicate device set. A distinction, not a collision. Its home is db_domain (11.3: the database proxy device).
answers.falsifier_check: Clauses: (1) after a sync on a remote box, every learning table the home box holds exists on the remote box, with the same owner and at least the home box's node ids; (2) a node row read on both boxes is identical; (3) 2b3d842bc118's clause_4_the_live_tables_are_hers runs green on akienasus. Horizon: at PROVEME after the design pass.
